primary_endpoint: mutation_score = killed non-equivalent executable mutants / non-equivalent executable mutants
unit_of_analysis: controlled mutant, not generated example or state transition

generated_method_seed_contract.development_behavior: The runner rejects a named generated-method suite without --hypothesis-seed and records the supplied seed in its raw artifact.
generated_method_seed_contract.final_freeze_requirement: Independently review and freeze a nonempty ordered seed list before locked execution; development seeds do not determine the final list.

unexecutable_rule: Unexecutable/equivalent mutants require prespecified documented exclusion and are never counted as killed.
freeze_rule: Seeds, Hypothesis version, limits, mutation manifest, code revision and backend must be frozen before execution.
